Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On May 19, 1911: Parks Canada, the world's first national park service, is established as the Dominion Parks Branch under the Department of the Interior.
On May 19, 1780: New England's Dark Day, an unusual darkening of the day sky, is observed over the New England states and parts of Canada.

On May 19, 1961: Venera program: Venera 1 becomes the first man-made object to fly by another planet by passing Venus (the probe had lost contact with Earth a month earlier and did not send back any data).
On May 19, 1883: Buffalo Bill's first Buffalo Bill's Wild West opens in Omaha, Nebraska.

On May 19, 1535: French explorer Jacques Cartier sets sail on his second voyage to North America with three ships, 110 men, and Chief Donnacona's two sons (whom Cartier had kidnapped during his first voyage).
